{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|text=The Droids Re-Animated, Part 1|int=The Droids Re-Animated}} establishes that the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] takes place fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.<noinclude>[[Category:Legends dating citation templates]]</noinclude>
